reviewed_rules.conclusion: Residuals are indexed by their valid time; shift(1) and trailing windows use only t-24h through t-1h or t-168h through t-1h. The explicit lag is t-24h. Early absent history stays missing, with counts preserved.
Each fit admits only labels with target strictly before the first evaluation origin. Test fits reuse validation-frozen cutoffs and do not call threshold selection.

Validation thresholds obey strict probability comparison, exact count fractions for admission/ranking, and documented cutoff ties. The selected larger configuration strictly outranks medium in the observed validation score tuple, so cross-configuration tie interpretation cannot change this selection.

Satellite outcomes are loaded and scored after frozen selection and all test predictions. They do not drive fitting or threshold changes; missing hours are retained and comparisons use identical common membership.

limits: Past residual context updates over evaluation time using earlier reference values; this is rolling-origin retrospective evaluation, not all evaluation-period forecasts issued together at its first origin.
Timestamp ordering does not establish historical publication or observation availability. The protocol already disclaims that evidence.
